title.narrative: In 2024, the PPSE unit strengthened strategic partnerships with private and public businesses and government entities, fostering responsible and sustainable business practices that support the rights of children. Key achievements included integration of child rights and business principles as well as family friendly policies within government of India’s mandate on ESG and responsible business thereby influencing corporate policies to prioritize child-friendly and family-friendly business models.
